hints.en: You do not know how many coins will come: `while due > 0:`.

hints.tr: Fazla atılınca `due` eksiye düşer; para üstü `-due`.
hints.en: When too much is paid, `due` goes negative; the change is `-due`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
due = 50
while due > 0:
    print("Amount Due:", due)
    coin = int(input("Insert Coin: "))
    if coin == 25 or coin == 10 or coin == 5:
        due -= coin
print("Change Owed:", -due)
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
due = 50
while due > 0:
    print("Amount Due:", due)
    coin = int(input("Insert Coin: "))
    if coin == 25 or coin == 10 or coin == 5:
        due -= coin
print("Change Owed:", -due)
```
